entry_key: opaque 32 lowercase hex characters scoped by user
write_guards: source span and original send time
atomic_unit: metadata-only idempotency receipt with source linkage
read_only_guards: owned active head and active revision
history_api: metadata only; not a retrieval path for old personal text
indexing: queued upsert/delete intents only; no worker, embeddings, Qdrant or cloud permission
forget: explicit current-source administrative request + owned exact target; allowed with collection off, old source missing or paused target; scrub revision plaintext and exclude all linked sources
replay: same request never reapplies memory or returns stored private text; changed input rejects; currently_usable is never asserted by an old receipt
disputed_state: schema/read gating only; P04 still must persist unresolved semantic conflicts
